newsitem.title: USA: NYC MAC sets $364 mln bond sale for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: NYC MAC sets $364 mln bond sale for Thursday.

text.p: The Municipal Assistance Corporation (MAC) for the City of New York on Tuesday said that it planned to sell about $364 million of refunding bonds on June 19.

The negotiated sale through Goldman, Sachs & Co. finishes the refunding that started last spring, MAC said in a statement. This enablies MAC to achieve its goal of saving $250 million in debt service committed for the city.
In late February, MAC approved selling $1.4 billion of bonds. It had expected to sell just over $390 million of fixed-rate bonds in October, through a syndicate led by Goldman, Sachs.
MAC was set up in the mid-1970s to help rescue New York City from its financial crisis.
